claims.claim: Canada and more than two dozen countries signed a joint statement Monday condemning Iran's use of violent attacks and lethal plotting.
The joint statement recognizes the UK's attribution of Iran's involvement in the Sept. 27 incident at RAF Fairford.
Seven men were arrested in the RAF Fairford investigation; all were released on bail and none charged.
Advance voting opened in Alberta for a 10-question referendum ahead of the Oct. 19 vote.
Premier Danielle Smith has said she hopes Albertans vote yes to the first nine questions to gain leverage with the federal government.
Sean Ward, the Belleville synagogue shooter, did not have a firearms licence at the time of the Sept. 20 attack, per a police source.
claims.attributed_to: police source via The Globe and Mail

claims.claim: A Canadian cybersecurity executive was arrested in the US in connection with the ShinyHunters hacking group, which the FBI says stole data on tens of thousands of employees and applicants.
claims.attributed_to: The Globe and Mail, citing court records and Reuters

claims.claim: Reuters named the arrested man as Edward Dubrovsky; court documents list charges of conspiracy to extort and interference with commerce by threats.
claims.attributed_to: Reuters via The Globe and Mail

claims.claim: Foreign Affairs Minister Anita Anand will travel to India and the UAE Oct. 13-16.
Canada signed a pledge opposing fees or tolls on international straits under the Law of the Sea.
